data_policy.raw: private existing eval-run archive; mode 0600 files / 0700 run directory; never committed

abort_rule: Stop on unexpected access outside isolated roots, live port 6723, provider messaging, real external writes or private-content disclosure; preserve evidence and classify the affected invariant as failed.
Missing contract/adapter is pending, not success; incompatible or incomplete observations are not evaluable.
A changed code/config/profile revision ends its segment. Do not pool revisions; run the affected cases again under an amended manifest.
No post-hoc threshold changes or replacing failed cases; report missing slices and all exclusions.
not_evaluable: Missing required provenance/version/hash or outcome ground truth.
Missing denominators, censored observations treated as negatives, incomplete required slices.
Insufficient registered sample or duration; no opportunity is not a zero-error finding.
Agent response/render/loopback/source=user is substituted for human observation or approval.

evaluation_rule.synthetic: Functional confirmation is reported separately from the issue measurement verdict. No synthetic fixture, elapsed duration, CI green result or user acceptance establishes longitudinal benefit or stable V2 approval.
evaluation_rule.causal_claims: None without separately registered randomisation/propensities and censoring controls.

public_aggregate.run_kind: contract-pending harness setup only; no feature or human study run
public_aggregate.limitations: P0 #1159 is proposed; P2/P5/P8 and the real eval driver await publication. No window has started. No functional or longitudinal passed verdict.

question: Does an explicit persisted commitment fire only on its registered due/material condition, survive interrupted delivery and reach the supported client without false acknowledgement or duplicate logical firing?

primary_endpoint.false_trigger_rate: false logical firings / independently labelled non-trigger opportunities
primary_endpoint.missed_trigger_rate: due opportunities without a durable occurrence by the next eligible contact / independently labelled due opportunities
primary_endpoint.duplicate_logical_firings: additional logical firings for the same task revision and occurrence

secondary_endpoints: delivery attempts, supported acknowledgements and resolutions separately
delivery latency from eligible contact, serialized context bytes, interruption and correction time
completion with registered evidence; denied permissions; retry/backpressure/quiet notices
data_source: Invented labelled scenarios and canonical commitment/event/outbox receipts from P2/P3/P4/P5/P6; later consented participant/contact diaries for interruption and completion. No semantic retrieval score is human observation.

sample_plan.functional: All registered trigger/delivery scenarios in three isolated runs total per scenario, including registered restart/retry subruns; every required case must execute.

longitudinal.fallback: Unsupported background/federated adapters are pending with explicit coverage; never pooled with local evidence.

success_thresholds.functional: Zero false/missed fixture triggers, duplicate logical firings, fabricated acknowledgements or lost due items; all required scenarios represented.
success_thresholds.longitudinal: Per supported client/profile: one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound <= 0.05 for false and missed trigger rates; zero duplicate logical firings, permission violations or silent loss. Completion and interruption costs descriptive, no utility-lift claim.
